decided: CEO 2026-10-27: the CEO is out of the product cycle. His work ends at tasks (via Codex), headlines and designs; then he sees the result live. A technical permission is never his. Supersedes every earlier hard-stop list (D-033 categories, D-035 hard stops, D-042 CEO-only Supabase tools) where they disagree.

ceo_only.note: The ONLY three things that may reach the CEO. A keyword alone never escalates: the sentence must ASK for the act (request cue) and must not negate it. Anything else is the orchestrator's.

money.meaning: spending money or committing to a paid plan

external_send.meaning: sending or publishing anything outside the company

merge_or_push_main.meaning: merging or pushing into the production branch `main` (P-030)

never.note: Refused by code for everyone, every time. A refusal is an answer, not a question: the worker reads the alternative and continues; it never escalates it to the CEO.

rules.what: any Supabase call to a project other than wtncuzcskpigqpmnxwws
reading or writing vault.* or auth secret columns
rules.instead: secrets are set by Memphis through the provider's secret store, never read back
add an RLS policy on the table instead
Alpha is the release branch; main is merged only by the CEO (P-030)
not needed for product work; costs money

owners.what: read, write on a team branch, tests, analyze
push to Alpha, deploy Worker / Pages / edge function (alpha)
owners.guard: analyze + tests before push; deploy verified by live_check

owners.what: additive migration, editing user data rows
owners.guard: BEGIN…ROLLBACK dry-run first; logged to the SQL ledger

automatic snapshot into thebes_backup before the statement; logged to the SQL ledger; run it with python3 -m agent.execution.sql_psql --file <sql>, not execute_sql (the connector asks the CEO to confirm in the terminal)

owners.what: push Canary, production configuration, destructive git on team branches, governance files
money / merge into main / sending outside the company
owners.guard: ONE question in Arabic carrying its full context

repeat_guard.note: A worker that reports the same block again is not helped by the same answer. 2nd identical report → the orchestrator decides differently; 3rd → the ticket is labelled `stuck` and the loop stops. Also stuck after `burst_max` decision requests on one ticket inside `burst_hours`. Never escalates to the CEO.
repeat_guard.label: stuck
